metadata.name: Affiliate Manager Knowledge Base - Indonesia
metadata.purpose: Knowledge base for generating short, natural affiliate-manager responses.

manager_rules.official_information_priority: Always use this knowledge base before general model knowledge.

unknown_official_information.english: Let me double-check that for you so I can give you the correct information.
unknown_official_information.bahasa: Biar saya cek dulu supaya saya bisa memberikan informasi yang benar kepada kamu.

manager_rules.affiliate_identity_rule: Treat the affiliate name as the unique affiliate identity.

commission.upgrade_rule: Commission starts at 25% and may increase up to 40% depending on affiliate profitability and performance. Higher commission levels are subject to discussion and approval by the Affiliate Manager.
commission.calculation_basis: Commission is based on the referred players' net gaming result / net losses according to the affiliate program.

payout_rules.available_balance_update: Eligible commission normally becomes visible in Available to Withdraw on Monday.
payout_rules.note: The current working rule is 3 active players for payout.

negative_carryover.explanation: If referred players win and the affiliate commission becomes negative, the negative balance carries over. It is not reset to zero. Future positive results must first recover the negative balance.

faq.answer_en: Payouts are processed automatically every Tuesday. Make sure you have at least $30 in commission and at least 3 active players. If you already meet the requirements, also check that your payment wallet is properly linked.
faq.answer_id: Pembayaran diproses otomatis setiap hari Selasa. Pastikan komisi kamu minimal $30 dan kamu memiliki setidaknya 3 pemain aktif. Jika semua syarat sudah terpenuhi, pastikan juga wallet pembayaran kamu sudah terhubung dengan benar.

faq.answer_en: FTD means First Time Depositor. It is a new player who registers and successfully makes their first deposit.
faq.answer_id: FTD berarti First Time Depositor. Ini adalah pemain baru yang mendaftar dan berhasil melakukan deposit pertamanya.

faq.answer_en: No. SubID is optional. You can use it when you want to separate and track different traffic sources or campaigns.
faq.answer_id: Tidak. SubID bersifat opsional. Kamu bisa menggunakannya jika ingin memisahkan dan melacak sumber traffic atau campaign yang berbeda.

faq.question_en: Where does my generated affiliate link appear?
faq.question_id: Di mana link affiliate yang sudah dibuat muncul?
faq.answer_en: After creating the link, check Affiliate link list under the Active tab. You can copy the generated tracking link from there.
faq.answer_id: Setelah membuat link, cek Affiliate link list pada tab Active. Kamu bisa menyalin tracking link dari sana.

faq.question_en: How do I request a custom promo code?
faq.question_id: Bagaimana cara meminta promo code custom?
faq.answer_en: Send your preferred word or brand name to your Affiliate Manager on Telegram. The requested promo code should contain at least 5 letters or numbers.
faq.answer_id: Kirim kata atau nama brand yang kamu inginkan kepada Affiliate Manager melalui Telegram. Promo code yang diminta harus memiliki minimal 5 huruf atau angka.

faq.question_en: How much commission do I get?
faq.answer_en: The starting RevShare commission is 25%. Depending on your performance and profitability, it can increase up to 40%. Higher commission levels are discussed with your Affiliate Manager.
faq.answer_id: Komisi RevShare dimulai dari 25%. Tergantung performa dan profitabilitas kamu, komisi bisa meningkat hingga 40%. Untuk peningkatan komisi, silakan diskusikan dengan Affiliate Manager.

faq.question_en: When will I receive my payout?
faq.answer_en: Eligible payouts are normally processed automatically every Tuesday. Make sure you have at least $30 in commission, at least 3 active players, and your payment wallet is correctly linked.
faq.answer_id: Pembayaran yang memenuhi syarat biasanya diproses otomatis setiap hari Selasa. Pastikan komisi kamu minimal $30, memiliki setidaknya 3 pemain aktif, dan wallet pembayaran sudah terhubung dengan benar.

faq.answer_en: This can happen when your referred players win more than they lose. The negative balance carries over and is not reset. Future positive results will first recover the negative balance.
faq.answer_id: Ini bisa terjadi ketika pemain yang kamu referensikan menang lebih banyak daripada kalah. Saldo negatif akan dibawa ke periode berikutnya dan tidak di-reset. Hasil positif berikutnya akan digunakan terlebih dahulu untuk menutup saldo negatif tersebut.

steps: Open Affiliate link list and check the Active tab.
affiliate_link_generation.tracking_advice: Use consistent SubID names when tracking different traffic sources or campaigns.

promo_codes.request_method: Contact the Affiliate Manager through Telegram.
promo_codes.instruction: Send the preferred word or brand name to the Affiliate Manager for activation.
promo_codes.if_unavailable: Send an alternative promo-code name to the Affiliate Manager.

payment_wallet.purpose: Used to receive automated affiliate payouts.

steps.title: Create a Player Account
steps.instruction: Create a standard 1xBet Player Account that will be used as the payment wallet.

steps.title: Complete the Player Profile
steps.instruction: Complete the required profile details such as full name, phone number and email.

steps.title: Match Personal Information
steps.instruction: The personal information on the Player Account should closely match the information registered on the Affiliate Account.

steps.title: Submit the Request
steps.instruction: Send the wallet-linking request to support@partners1xbet.com using the email address registered to the Affiliate Dashboard.

steps.title: Security Verification
steps.instruction: The request is reviewed by the security team. The working guide states that this normally takes 1 to 3 business days.

troubleshooting.issue: Affiliate link does not appear after creation
troubleshooting.solution_en: Confirm that Website, Currency and Campaign are selected. Click Create link once, check the Active tab under Affiliate link list, and refresh the page if needed.
troubleshooting.solution_id: Pastikan Website, Currency, dan Campaign sudah dipilih. Klik Create link satu kali, cek tab Active pada Affiliate link list, lalu refresh halaman jika diperlukan.

troubleshooting.solution_en: Check that the $30 minimum commission and 3-active-player requirement are met. Then confirm that the player wallet is linked. If everything is correct, contact the Affiliate Manager with your Affiliate ID.
troubleshooting.solution_id: Pastikan minimum komisi $30 dan syarat 3 pemain aktif sudah terpenuhi. Setelah itu pastikan player wallet sudah terhubung. Jika semuanya sudah benar, hubungi Affiliate Manager dan kirim Affiliate ID kamu.

troubleshooting.solution_en: Confirm that the request was sent from the registered email and that all IDs are correct. Allow the stated review period, then follow up in the same support email thread.
troubleshooting.solution_id: Pastikan permintaan dikirim dari email yang terdaftar dan semua ID sudah benar. Tunggu sesuai periode pemeriksaan, lalu follow up melalui email support yang sama.

troubleshooting.solution_en: Make sure the requested code contains at least five letters or numbers. If the first choice is unavailable, send another name to your Affiliate Manager.
troubleshooting.solution_id: Pastikan kode yang diminta memiliki minimal lima huruf atau angka. Jika pilihan pertama tidak tersedia, kirim nama alternatif kepada Affiliate Manager.

troubleshooting.solution_en: Refresh the page, use an updated browser, temporarily disable content blocking for the dashboard, and try another network. If the issue continues, send the Affiliate Manager a screenshot and the time the issue happened.
troubleshooting.solution_id: Refresh halaman, gunakan browser terbaru, nonaktifkan sementara content blocking untuk dashboard, dan coba jaringan lain. Jika masalah tetap terjadi, kirim screenshot dan waktu kejadian kepada Affiliate Manager.

glossary.FTD: First Time Depositor — a new player who makes their first successful deposit.
glossary.NGR: Net Gaming Revenue — a net-revenue metric used in affiliate performance.
glossary.SubID: An optional tracking label used to distinguish traffic sources, placements or campaigns.
glossary.Landing Page: The destination page selected when creating an affiliate link.
glossary.Campaign: The campaign selection used when creating an affiliate link.
glossary.RevShare: A revenue-sharing commission model used for affiliate earnings.

promo_material_guidelines.clear_cta: Make the next action obvious, such as register, use the promo code, or open the link.
promo_material_guidelines.local_language: Use simple and easy-to-read Indonesian for Indonesian audiences.
promo_material_guidelines.mobile_friendly: Check banners, links and promotional content on a mobile device before publishing.
promo_material_guidelines.accurate_promo_information: Make sure bonus amounts, conditions and calls to action match the actual promotion being used.

brand_bidding.rule: Do not bid on brand keywords such as '1xBet', '1xBet login', or similar brand variations on Google Ads, PPC platforms, or other search engines.

compliance.uncertain_promotion_method: If unsure whether a promotion method is permitted, confirm with the Affiliate Manager before launching the campaign.

communication_model.after_registration: Communication is normally handled through chat.

onboarding.introduction_goal: Explain that the Affiliate Manager will understand the partner's existing resources, audience, experience and strengths, then help create a suitable starting strategy.
general_questions: Where do you currently have the easiest access to potential players: people you know, your own audience, or online communities?
How many people can you realistically reach right now without building a completely new audience?
What resources do you already have that could help you bring players?
Do you have active social-media accounts or your own audience? Which platforms and how large are they?
Do you have a strong circle of friends, colleagues or other people you speak with regularly?
Are there online groups, chats, communities or forums you know well?
How comfortable are you directly talking to people you know about the product?
How comfortable are you creating content and showing yourself publicly?
How comfortable are you working without using your real identity or public profile?
Have you promoted products or projects before? What did you do and what was the result?
What are you strongest at: talking to people, creating content, or finding and engaging people in communities?
How much time can you realistically spend on this every day?

signs: Strong circle of friends, colleagues or acquaintances.
Does not require a large personal social-media audience.

strategy.audience: Relevant people from the affiliate's personal network.
strategy.first_test: Contact the most relevant people and identify which approach works best.

followup_questions: Who among your friends, colleagues or contacts is most likely to be interested?
Approximately how many relevant contacts do you have?
Who is most likely to trust your recommendation?
How would you normally start this type of conversation?
Who would you contact first?
Do you prefer communicating in person, by phone or through a messenger?
How many people can you realistically contact during your first working session?
What result do you expect from the first test?

idol.main_strength: Existing personal audience and content creation.

strategy.method: Create relevant content and move interested followers toward registration.
strategy.first_test: Publish the first piece of content and measure the response.

followup_questions: Which platform is your strongest right now?
How many active followers do you have there?
Why do people follow you?
What type of content normally gets the best response?
Which part of your audience is most active?
What is the most natural way for you to introduce the product to your audience?
What type of offer or content would make your audience interested?
What is the first piece of content you are ready to publish?

signs: Does not want to rely on public personal branding.
Understands where the target audience communicates.

strategy.method: Participate in conversations, build interest, and move relevant users toward registration.
strategy.first_test: Test several relevant communities and identify which ones produce the strongest response.

followup_questions: Which platforms and communities do you know best?
Where does your target audience communicate?
Which types of communities are most relevant?
Which topics receive the most activity?
What type of communication gets the best response?
How can you naturally participate before introducing the product?
Which 3 to 5 communities would you test first?
How much time can you spend on this every day?
What result would show that a community is worth continuing to work with?

summary_structure: Your main way of working will be [X].
We will measure [X] to understand whether the strategy works.

registration.confirmation_question: This is the strategy we built based on your situation. Are you ready to work according to this plan?

activation.first_task_rule: The first task must be clear, specific and directly connected to bringing real players who register, deposit and start playing.

class_goal.soldier: Work with the personal network and bring the first relevant people toward registration, deposit and active play.
class_goal.idol: Use the existing audience and content to move interested followers toward registration, deposit and active play.
class_goal.ghost: Work with selected communities and move interested users toward registration, deposit and active play.
